newsitem.title: PANAMA: Unemployed ransack Panama ministry, 200 arrested.
newsitem.headline: Unemployed ransack Panama ministry, 200 arrested.

text.p: Unemployed Panamanians ransacked the offices of the housing ministry on Monday to protest against the government's failure to provide jobs, and police said they arrested 200 demonstrators.
Several hundred people entered the housing ministry, smashing windows and furniture, and shouted at Housing Minister Francisco Sanchez Cardenas.
"You have not done enough. We are still waiting," one angry demonstrator told the minister.
Riot police entered the ministry and dispersed the demonstrators with batons. Police said 200 were arrested and taken away in six buses.
A program funded by the housing ministry promised to create work in Panama's second city Colon, a port on the Atlantic coast where one in four workers is out of a job.
